title: Crowns in the Dark
summary: Gus has seen something on a far crag wearing a crown of bone, and the dead around it walk in step.
ask: Gus: I've seen it. I'm sure now.
Gus: A king, or something that wants to be. Crown of bone, the others move when it moves. I'm too old for this, but you aren't.

done: Bones piled into steps. At the top, a seat, and the dark in front of it is full of shapes.

start: The shapes stand up together, as if someone had called a name.
done: The court falls. Behind it, something taller stands up from the seat.
The guard goes down. The crown rolls across the stone and stops against your boot.
Gus: Bone. Plain bone. All that fuss over a hat.
Gus: Here. I'll keep the crown, you keep the thanks of every road within a week's walk.
